title: aster incanus
intro: Aster incanus, commonly known as Pale Aster or Wood's Aster, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. It is an herbaceous perennial plant that has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Aster incanus include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can aid in the treatment of wounds and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Aster incanus include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
